text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Haru Urara has a number
of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! One, two...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I finished my run! What's next?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, Haru Urara has been working
even
harder than before. I wonder if
there's something I
can do to repay her
efforts...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want a treat! Take me to the hot
springs as a
treat someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oh, I remember now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really?! Let's go, let's gooo!
choice_data_list: ウララ、そろそろ温泉に行くか？
ウララ、そろそろ温泉に行く？

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But why there?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? In the raffle? When was that,
again?
choice_data_list: 福引で当てたご褒美の……

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I don't really remember, but yay! I get to go to the hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs! Hot springs! Urara, la la
la!♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: じゃあ誰かお友だちを誘っておいで

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wanna go with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I even know what's happening...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew! ♪ The water felt amazing, huh, Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Were you able to relax? Do you feel
refreshed?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Yeah, you look it! You must have
put your
whole body in!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's hang out in your room next!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a massage! My family says I
give the
best massages!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're always working so hard, Trainer!
I'm sure
your shoulders could use a little
relief.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Today's a treat for the both of us!
choice_data_list: 気持ちは嬉しいけど、どうして？

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because if I'm working hard, that
means
you are too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So let's treat each other today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a massage, and while we're
at it, let's
have fun chatting!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And... heh...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Your smile will be my treat!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I hope you like your treat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we both relax and enjoy our
treats.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Haru Urara and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
